goals.title: Goal 3
goals.description: Generate actionable insights through structured user testing workflows and embed those insights directly into product decisions.

actions.title: Define and document a repeatable User Testing Workflow  by Q2 2026.
Conduct at least 2 structured user testing activities per active project per year
Ensure at least of 80% of test finding are linked to back to backlog
User Testing Insight Repository : Become Subject Matter Expert on Platform User Insights
User Testing Insight Repository : Generate key pain points and opportunity areas
User Testing Insight Repository : Cluster user comments into themes
Present user testing learnings at least 2 times internally (guild, demo, stakeholder forum).
Conduct at least 1 customer site visit or co-creation session.

“I commit to delivering high-quality, user-centered design solutions that elevate the UX experience in OneSpace, ensuring alignment with business impact, usability best practices, and measurable design improvements. Through structured design workflows, continuous validation, and data-driven insights, I will drive meaningful enhancements that improve user satisfaction and efficiency.”

“I commit to fostering design consistency and simplification by strengthening UX alignment across teams. By driving Filament adoption, refining design patterns, and contributing to a unified component library, I will ensure a seamless, intuitive, and scalable design system that enhances user experience across applications.”

“I commit to actively engaging with the design community and contributing to meaningful cross-functional programs. By leading initiatives like the Digital Design Guild, organizing knowledge-sharing sessions, and collaborating with global and social impact teams, I will expand my strategic thinking, elevate design impact, and foster a culture of continuous learning and innovation.”

goals.title: Goal 1
goals.description: Elevate OneSpace Customer Experience quality and execution excellence by measuring UX standards by improving delivery speed, reducing UX debt, and strengthening design–development alignment through AI-enabled workflows, requirement documentation and structured quality checks.

actions.title: Create empty states and error messaging faster
Reduce requirement alignment documentation time by 30% by Q4 2026.
Auto-summarising stakeholder notes
Converting workshop outputs into structured requirements
Generate UX copy variations
Generate edge-case flows
Define UX success metrics for at least 1 critical workflow.
Account Activation & Onboarding
Deliver at least 1 telemetry-driven UX improvement.
Conduct a monthly Dev–Design Gap analysis meeting (sanity check on implemented vs. designed flows).
Identify and log UX debt items in backlog. (37 Identified in Q1 26)
Identify and report UX inconsistencies, and push for reduction by 50% by Q2-3 2026. ( 18-19 solved in Q2-3 26)
Create requirement document before every feature initiation
1 design critique per quarter per active project.

goals.title: Goal 2
goals.description: Simplify the design process clarity in Customer profile projects by implementing a repeatable, standardised product/feature design workflow that increases predictability and stakeholder confidence.

actions.title: Apply standardised workflow: Requirement Alignment doc
Apply standardised workflow: UX principle checklist and DoD checklist for Dev Handoff
Apply standardised workflow: Decision Log
Apply standardised workflow: Single source of truth specs
Advocate Integrating simpler DoD in UX Documentation
Create a template for the team, which will improve productivity and design quality of the team.
≥80% work tracked in backlog.
Ad-hoc work <20%.
≥80% PI goals met from Q3 onward.

goals.title: Goal 4
goals.description: Strengthen the influence of design within the Service Experience community by improving strategic communication and storytelling that clearly connects design decisions to business value, service workflows, and customer outcomes. Through design studio activities, knowledge sharing, and collaborative sessions, promote shared UX standards and encourage broader adoption of design thinking across teams.

actions.title: Advocate and secure alignment for at least 1 UX improvement despite initial stakeholder resistance.
Seek mentorship or feedback from senior design leaders or communication experts to strengthen strategic framing.
Contribute at least 1 UX principle or guideline to Service toolkit.
Contribute to 1–2 case studies.
Conduct or participate in design share-outs or storytelling sessions (e.g., guilds, showcases, or cross-team reviews) to refine storytelling clarity and impact.
